subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 17th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: Day 17 – The Stone of Diirinka

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: journal entry date
fact: The journal entry is dated Day 25 – The Prince's Gift Arrives.
source_quote: Day 25 – The Prince's Gift Arrives

subject: journal entry date
fact: The journal entry is dated Day 38 – Mutagenic Progress!
source_quote: Day 38 – Mutagenic Progress!

subject: journal entry date
fact: The journal entry is dated Day 47 – The Obelisk Responds.
source_quote: Day 47 – The Obelisk Responds

subject: journal entry date
fact: The journal entry is dated Day 54 – Anticipation and Destiny.
source_quote: Day 54 – Anticipation and Destiny

subject: dragon egg value
fact: The dragon egg is a vessel for Demogorgon's greatest creation, a two-headed wyrmling destined to serve as his mount.
source_quote: The Red Dragon Egg! What a marvel! ... This is no mere insurance policy; it is the vessel for my greatest creation, a gift worthy of Demogorgon himself.

subject: obelisk energy
fact: The Obelisk's black metal hums with quasi-magical energy, a power just waiting to be unleashed.
source_quote: Its black metal hums with quasi-magical energy, a power just waiting to be unleashed.

subject: thrazgad ore
fact: The Thrazgad ore has been discarded and forgotten next to the workbenches, resisting all attempts to mend the Obelisk’s fractures.
source_quote: It merely sits "discarded and forgotten" next to my workbenches.

subject: derro guard post
fact: A derro guard post is located at the cave entrance, where Diirdeklin watches for intruders.
source_quote: Diirdeklin has been at this guard post for days.

subject: group naming
fact: The group adopts the name 'The Ember Vanguard' after Thorin proposes it.
source_quote: I have it - The Ember Vanguard.

subject: baby dragon rattle
fact: A giant baby rattle made by Clan Thrazgad is found, inscribed with 'made by clan Thrazgad'.
source_quote: It says made by clan Thrazgad.

subject: double doors
fact: A pair of double doors leads from the cave tunnel, guarded by a squad of derro.
source_quote: they go down a different cave tunnel, which leads to a pair of double doors. In front of those double doors is a small squad of derro.

subject: drow incursion
fact: A Drow Archmage summons a meteor swarm and declares the group as 'The Ember Vanguard'.
source_quote: We are The Ember Vanguard, and you will let us pass!

subject: dancing lights effect
fact: Daz's use of dancing lights intimidated the derro guard, enabling passage.
source_quote: Daz is very pleased with his use of dancing lights and the effect it had on the Derro.

subject: escape plan
fact: The group plans to give the egg to Gartokkar and use him to escape Gracklstugh, blaming the Derro for its theft.
source_quote: We tell Gartokkar that the Derro didn’t steal the egg, but some other crazed group. We also explain that we need his help to escape...

subject: journal source
fact: Pliinki's Journal is found, detailing her macabre experiments and fervent beliefs.
source_quote: Pliinki's Journal

subject: letter source
fact: Four letters from Pliinki, Aliinka, and Narrak to Uskvil and others detail the conspiracy to destabilize Gracklstugh.
source_quote: He also finds some letters

subject: temple teaching
fact: Grygum recalls Bahamut’s teaching: 'To break the chains of another's dark design... is to affirm the very freedom Bahamut cherishes.'
source_quote: "When the egg, crimson-hued, promises but a shadow's ride, does one mend the shell, or seek to free the spark within? ... To break the chains of another's dark design... is to affirm the very freedom Bahamut cherishes."

subject: desk location
fact: A desk with some papers is located in the northwest corner of the chamber.
source_quote: he heads to the northwest corner where there is a desk with some papers.

subject: alcove location
fact: An alcove in the northeast corner holds the statue of Demogorgon.
source_quote: Zalthir jumps off the mesa and heads to an alcove in the northeast corner. There, he picks up the statue of Demogorgon.

subject: group departure
fact: The Ember Vanguard departs the chamber of the Obelisk via a different tunnel to avoid the Empty Scabbard Killers.
source_quote: As Zalthir explains, 'The Empty Scabbard Killers might want to kill us.' ... they go down a different cave tunnel
